# Assets · Hero

1 file under `assets/Hero/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for hero-face-grid.webp>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

`hero-face-grid.webp` (2160 × 839) is the flattened face-and-silhouette banner from the homepage design. In code it is:

1. the starting layout the animated grid reproduces,
2. the still image shown under `prefers-reduced-motion`,
3. the fallback if the script doesn't run.

It isn't the animation source; that comes from `Portraits/`.
